why_ai: Booking is screen work AI agents and OTAs already do, but leisure clients pay for a trusted advisor's judgement on fit and for someone to fix the trip when it breaks.
why_clarity: A booked trip is checkable, but whether the match was right is partly taste and known only after travel, if the client reports it.
why_digital: Research, booking and documents are digital, though many clients still choose an advisor through local referral and personal relationship.

why_ai: Booking and routine servicing are being absorbed by self-service tools; disruption handling and programme relationships are the protected remainder.
why_clarity: Policy, fares and fees are explicit and transactions recur by the million, though savings and compliance are negotiated measures.
why_digital: Bookings, policies and reports are digital, bought through RFPs that are mostly remote but favour regional service.

why_ai: Getting employees to book and change trips in software is exactly what AI-native booking tools compete on.
why_clarity: Adoption and touchless rates are exact measures over thousands of near-identical bookings.
why_digital: Entirely online booking and servicing, sold remotely to finance teams.

why_ai: Employers carry a legal duty of care and need accountable people deciding responses in an incident, though locating travellers automates.
why_clarity: Whether every traveller was accounted for is checkable, but incidents are rare and each one differs.
why_digital: Itinerary, card and location data in, alerts and dashboards out, bought by corporate security teams remotely.

why_ai: Clients pay for a specific advisor's taste and supplier relationships, and amenities depend on human relationships with properties.
why_clarity: Each luxury trip is bespoke, good is partly taste, and outcomes surface only after travel.
why_digital: Research and booking are on screen, but advisors are chosen through referral and personal trust.

why_ai: Couples and group leaders want one trusted person managing guests and suppliers, sometimes on site, which AI assists but does not replace.
why_clarity: Blocks fill or attrite against contract dates, but each group's guests behave differently.
why_digital: Contracts and payments are digital, but coordination runs through texts, calls and in-person relationships with the couple.

why_ai: Community trust, shared language and an agent who answers at night keep families loyal despite cheaper online fares.
why_clarity: Fares and change rules are explicit and requests recur, though net-fare rules vary by consolidator.
why_digital: Tickets are electronic, but quotes, payment and service happen at a neighbourhood counter and by phone.

why_ai: The hosted advisor's clients come through personal networks, but research and proposal work are increasingly automated.
why_clarity: Bookings are checkable but matching quality and client satisfaction are judged slowly and loosely.
why_digital: Advisors work from home on screens, recruited and supported by hosts entirely online.

why_ai: Verifying that a trip works for a specific disability takes trusted human judgement and on-the-ground checks, and demand grows with an ageing population.
why_clarity: Each traveller's needs differ and verification methods vary by specialist, with outcomes known only on arrival.
why_digital: Research is on screen, but verification depends on physical measurements and site knowledge.

why_ai: Applying fare rules to exchanges and refunds is codified work software automates directly.
why_clarity: Fare rules and settlement have exact right answers, and debit memos give objective feedback on errors.
why_digital: Entirely electronic transactions, settlement and reporting.

why_ai: Matching payments to bookings and chasing gaps is document extraction and matching that AI does well.
why_clarity: Each commission matches or not against a computable amount, at volume.
why_digital: Statements and bookings in, matched ledgers and claims out, all digital.

why_ai: Judging an unfolding incident's risk to travellers is high-stakes and ambiguous, and corporate buyers keep paying for a named, accountable provider, though AI monitoring of open sources is eroding the alerting half of the product.
why_clarity: Alerts and ratings recur in standard form, but whether a rating was right is rarely checked.
why_digital: Open-source and network reports in, alerts and ratings out, sold online worldwide.

why_ai: Clients hire experienced consultants for negotiations and programme design where judgement and relationships with suppliers matter.
why_clarity: RFP and sourcing methods are established, but savings attribution is negotiated and results arrive over a programme year.
why_digital: Client data in, analyses and recommendations out, with some in-person negotiation.

why_ai: Automated fare shopping and analytics are software, defended mainly by the archive.
why_clarity: Fare observations are exact and collected at enormous volume.
why_digital: Fares collected online and delivered as data feeds to remote buyers.

why_ai: Programme reporting from client data is analytics that AI-native platforms produce directly.
why_clarity: Spend and compliance reports recur on defined metrics, though savings definitions are negotiated.
why_digital: Booking and card data in, dashboards and reviews out, delivered digitally with some in-person reviews.

why_ai: Data consolidation, rate audits and hotel re-shopping are mechanical tasks software performs at scale.
why_clarity: A rate is loaded or not and a re-shop saves money or not, checked instantly.
why_digital: Entirely digital data in and reports out.

why_ai: The dataset is the moat and its preparation is automated; buyers will keep paying for the only complete record of agency bookings.
why_clarity: Data products are produced by defined processing at volume.
why_digital: Booking records in, data feeds out, sold to airlines worldwide.

why_ai: Market-sizing reports built largely on public data are increasingly drafted by AI, leaving reputation and conference access as protection.
why_clarity: Methods recur annually but forecasts are rarely graded and estimates differ between publishers.
why_digital: Surveys and filings in, reports out, sold online.

why_ai: Production reporting is automatable; the negotiations it supports rest on relationships.
why_clarity: Production by supplier is exact, though partner value is negotiated.
why_digital: Member sales data in, scorecards out, with in-person partner negotiations.

why_ai: Settlement is mandated infrastructure and its data is unique, though processing it is automated.
why_clarity: Settled transactions are exact and recur by the hundred million.
why_digital: Entirely electronic settlement and data delivery.

why_ai: Rate filings need accountable actuaries, though pricing and claims analytics automate heavily.
why_clarity: Claims recur at volume with defined causes, though loss outcomes accumulate over seasons.
why_digital: Policy and claims data in, prices and analyses out, sold through state-regulated channels.

why_ai: Agency production analytics are internal reporting that software produces.
why_clarity: Production by agency is exact and recurs, though tier decisions involve judgement.
why_digital: Booking data in, internal reports out, with trade-sales relationships in person.

why_ai: Statutory enforcement authority cannot be substituted, though complaint analysis automates.
why_clarity: Rules are codified and complaints recur, but enforcement outcomes take months.
why_digital: Complaints and filings are digital; jurisdiction is national.

why_ai: Batch commission payment is a processing service software runs end to end.
why_clarity: Payments are exact and recur at enormous volume.
why_digital: Entirely electronic payment and remittance.

why_ai: Associations persist on member relationships, advocacy and in-person events more than on analysis.
why_clarity: Surveys and certifications follow set methods, but advocacy outcomes are slow and contested.
why_digital: Mixed in-person conventions and digital programmes, bought by members nationally.

why_ai: Statutory registration and enforcement authority persists, though processing automates.
why_clarity: Registration rules are codified and checkable, recurring annually.
why_digital: Filings are digital; jurisdiction is state by state.

why_ai: Clients hire named experts for contested distribution strategy, though research synthesis automates.
why_clarity: Each engagement is bespoke and outcomes play out over contract cycles.
why_digital: Interviews and data in, reports out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Agency software faces AI-native competitors, though installed back offices are sticky.
why_clarity: Software behaviour is specified and testable across many customers.
why_digital: Software in, software out, sold online.

why_ai: Owners hire a trusted broker to run a confidential negotiated sale, which AI does not replace.
why_clarity: Valuation methods exist but each sale is bespoke and outcomes private.
why_digital: Valuations are on screen, deals run through industry relationships.
